Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Greets again!

Can you play Inspire Greatness on a minion during combat?

Inspire Greatness

[Action Modifier] Action Modifier

[Potence] Potence & [Presence] Presence

[1 Blood]

Only usable by a ready vampire other than the acting minion.
[pot]  The acting ally or younger vampire gets +1 strength during this action.
[POT]  The acting ally or younger vampire gets +2 strength during this action.

NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
No.
Rulebook 6.4  wrote:
>
> Note: The only minion cards that can be played during combat are combat cards (unless a card states otherwise, of course).
>

Messages.Author: Lambach
Messages.Body: But you could play it after a block has been declared, right? Right before combat effectively?

Messages.Author: Louhi
Messages.Body:
Would there be a window for using inspire greatness on a blood brother ambush, after they're put in play but before they enter combat?

Blood Brother Ambush
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Brujah antitribu
Cost: 2 blood
Only usable when an action is blocked.
Combat does not occur. Put this card into play. While in play, this card represents an ally with 3 life and 2 strength who can strike for 2R damage; this ally enters combat with the blocking minion. Blood Brothers may play cards requiring basic Potence as a vampire with a capacity of 3. Any cost in blood is paid with life. If a card would give them blood, give them life instead. Burn this card at the end of combat or if the combat is canceled

Edit: Thanks Reyda, forgot the acting part!

Lidingö Scourge

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
No, because the Blood Brothers Ambush are absolutely not an "acting minion" (card text on inspire greatness)
